note: Custer County, CO publishes its zoning districts only as a PDF map (Custer-County-Colorado-Zoning-Map.pdf, an embedded JPEG image). The GIS & Maps page links no ArcGIS REST service or downloadable zoning layer; the only interactive viewer linked is the third-party ReGrid parcel site. Westcliffe and Silver Cliff publish zoning only as PDF ordinance text or map files, with no GIS layer found.
